description.narrative: (Lebanon): With FY 2024 resources, USAID, through its Trade and Investment Activity (TIF), will create trade and investment hubs and networks of local stakeholders within sectors, aiming to reform economic governance, and to engage buyers across Lebanon, the MENA region, and globally so as to expand access to markets for Lebanese goods and services. Additionally, TIF will utilize the Higher Education Economic Crises Directive (HEED) funds to work with U.S. accredited universities - The American University of Beirut, the Lebanese American University, and Notre Dame University - on curricula related to productive sectors such as information and communication technology, industry and others, with the purpose of increasing job-relevant skills among students, and to develop vocational training programs for current jobholders to enhance their skills and productivity.
